locator: Sheet 27 (1891 edition sheets 245-252): E. 18th to E. 20th St., S. Michigan Av. to the 24-ft alley behind Indiana Av.'s east-face lots. 5873 x 7323 px, 0.0505 m to the pixel at the printed Scale of Feet, as sheets 20 and 28.
note: Spent first by T-3150: georeferenced by tools/georef_prairie_1904.py, TIED to sheets 20 and 28 at the three crossings it shares with them (data/traces/gcp/sanborn_1911_v3_sheet_27_gcps.json), and Indiana Avenue's east-face lots from 18th to 20th read off it into the 1904 street grid by tools/trace_prairie_1904_grid.py. Its buildings are T-3151's.
what_it_supplies: Lots, lot lines and the 1911 street numbers of Indiana Avenue's east face from 18th to 20th Street, and the corner lots' East 18th and East 20th Street numbers
Indiana Avenue's two property lines, 18th to 20th, drawn rather than interpolated between sheets 20 and 35
Footprints, material colour, storeys and use of the buildings on those lots as of 1911 (read by T-3151, not here)
what_it_does_not_supply: Anything as of 1904 on its own authority. It is a 1911 survey, and Glessner House's reading that sheets 20, 28 and 35 changed little between 1904 and 1911 was not made of this sheet
A construction date for any building it draws
Elevations, grades, curb heights or fill depths -- no Sanborn sheet carries a level
Architecture above the footprint beyond its story count, material colour and roof symbol
Michigan Avenue and its lots, which it draws but nothing here reads yet
